exchanges.author: c_paul
exchanges.subject: Journal approval workflow: proposed fix
exchanges.body: Elena, Rachel asked me to fix the delegate rule after your JE-10310 email. Proposal: (1) block approval when the approver is the entry's creator, including through delegation; (2) when an approver is out of office, route to the next level up (Tom's queue goes to Rachel); (3) keep the tiers: staff entries to you up to 50,000, over 50,000 and your entries to Tom or Rachel. I'll build it in the sandbox tomorrow. Could you send me test cases you'd want to see pass before we move it to production? Paul

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Paul, test cases I'd want to pass in the sandbox before production: (1) I create a JE and Tom is out of office: it must route to Rachel, never to me as his delegate. (2) Any preparer, any amount: the creator can never approve their own entry, directly or through a delegation. (3) Staff entry of 49,999.99 routes to me; 50,000.01 routes to Tom, or to Rachel when Tom is out. (4) Rachel's own entries route to Vince. (5) A preparer edits an entry after approval: it goes back to pending. (6) The approval history shows the approver's name and timestamp on the JE listing saved search (the auditors use it for PBC 7). Could you also run a one-time report of every JE this year where creator = approver, so we have the full list? Elena
